text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I'm walking along the riverside, a
canoe stops
at the bank and an
Umamusume hops off.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
At long last! Land ho! Hail, yon traveler!
Riddle
me this!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What does one need to survive upon
these
yet-to-be-traversed lands?! Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What a coincidence! I was thinking the
same
thing!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Righty-o! To commemorate this
occasion, I'll
teach you the secret to
building stamina! You
wanna hear it?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The secret is... finding it yourself!
Otherwise this
whole charade is
meaningless!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Remember—one must always have an

adventurous heart!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that cryptic exclamation, Gold Ship
returns
to her canoe and paddles down
the river...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, it's important to stick to your
guns if you
want any hope of surviving in
a harsh
environment!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And if it's sticky things you want, well,
what's
stickier than natto?! In other
words, if you eat
natto...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That's right! You'll stick to your guns like
none
other and will never give up!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
By the way, natto tastes way better and
fluffier if
you mix it up first before
adding soy sauce! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that cryptic exclamation, Gold Ship
returns
to her canoe and paddles down
the river...
